jog.definition:
n. a sharp change in direction
n. a slow pace of running
v. run for exercise
v. give a slight push to
jog.translation:
n. 轻推, 轻撞, 慢跑
v. 轻推, (使)蹒跚行进, (使)慢跑

jog sb's memory.translation: 唤起某人的记忆, 提醒某人

jogged.definition:
v continue talking or writing in a desultory manner
v even up the edges of a stack of paper, in printing
v run for exercise
v run at a moderately swift pace
v give a slight push to
v stimulate to remember

jogger.definition: n. someone who runs a steady slow pace (usually for exercise)
jogger.translation: n. 慢跑者；[印刷]撞纸机

joggers.definition: n. someone who runs a steady slow pace (usually for exercise)
joggers.translation: n. 慢跑锻炼者( jogger的复数形式 )

jogging.definition: n. running at a jog trot as a form of cardiopulmonary exercise

joggle.definition:
n. a slight irregular shaking motion
v. fasten or join with a joggle
joggle.translation:
v. 轻摇, 摇动, 摇曳, 啮合
n. 轻摇, 摇动, 啮合扣
[计] 轻摇

joggled.translation: v. 轻摇( joggle的过去式和过去分词 ); 摇动; 摇曳; 啮合

joggles.definition:
n a fastener that is inserted into holes in two adjacent pieces and holds them together
n a slight irregular shaking motion
v move to and fro
v fasten or join with a joggle
joggles.translation: v. 轻摇（joggle的第三人称单数形式）

jogglework.translation: 啮合工作, 镶接工作

joggling.definition:
v move to and fro
v fasten or join with a joggle

jogjakarta.translation: 日惹[印度尼西亚爪哇岛南部城市](或译周贾卡塔)

jogs.definition:
n a sharp change in direction
n a slow pace of running
n a slight push or shake
v continue talking or writing in a desultory manner
v even up the edges of a stack of paper, in printing
v run for exercise
v run at a moderately swift pace
v give a slight push to
v stimulate to remember
jogs.translation: v. （使）慢走, 慢跑( jog的第三人称单数 ); 轻敲, 轻推

jogtrot.translation: v. 缓步而行,款款而行
